title: Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works
alt: A dry red plain under a red sky with huge dark gear wheels and bars of smoke. Swords without number stand in the plain, to a horizon that glows. Far off, at the left, a low hill is thick with swords against the light. In the middle distance a boy with rust-red hair, in a white shirt with blue sleeves, walks toward the hill with his back to us. He holds a short sword in each hand, one white and one black, and his long shadow comes toward us. Great swords stand close to us at each side.
summary: A painting of the Unlimited Blade Works from Fate/stay night in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is Unlimited Blade Works, from Fate/stay night, a visual novel by Type-Moon. It is the world inside the hero Archer, made real: a dry plain, a sky of gears, a hill, and every sword that he has seen.

The boy is Shirou. He walks toward the hill with his back to us. The white sword in his right hand is Bakuya, and the black sword in his left hand is Kanshou. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
